app_store.name: CardForge: Open Graph Studio
app_store.subtitle: Dynamic Social Share Cards
app_store.promotional_text: Create dynamic link preview images for your blog posts with a high-speed parametric API.
app_store.description:
CardForge automates Open Graph and Twitter Card images for your website.

Never share a link with a broken or boring preview again. Design cards in a live visual studio, and automate previews with our sub-50ms edge rendering API.

Key features:
- 4 responsive layout themes
- Dark and light color schemes
- 9 SVG background patterns
- 1-click code snippets for Next.js, HTML, and Markdown
- Instant edge caching with zero database lock-in
app_store.whats_new: Initial release of CardForge with sub-50ms Edge generation.
